root_cause.text: The mesh_send() function failed to validate that the embedded adv_data_len field matches the actual flexible array data provided in the command, allowing a truncated MGMT_OP_MESH_SEND command to pass length checks and cause out-of-bounds buffer access during async mesh send operations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit validation `expected_len = struct_size(send, adv_data, send->adv_data_len); if (expected_len != len)` to ensure the command length exactly matches the fixed header plus the declared adv_data_len. Previously, the code only checked `len <= MGMT_MESH_SEND_SIZE + 31`, which validates the total command size but does not verify that the flexible array size matches the embedded length field, enabling a truncated command with mismatched adv_data_len to bypass validation and later "drive the async mesh send path past the end of the queued command buffer."
